changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5793-spec-range-floors.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > Nothing a consumer installs today changes: normal resolution already picks the newest 17.x, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still resolves 17.2.0 on this edge after the bump. The change is to the declared floor only, which is why it is scored `patch` rather than `minor` — the same reasoning objectui#5753 used for the other direction on this dependency.

### `.changeset/6361-spec-floor-17-2-0.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > Nothing a consumer installs today changes: normal resolution already picks the newest 17.x, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still resolves `17.2.0` on both edges after the bump — only the recorded `specifier:` moves. No source and no behaviour changes, which is why this is scored `patch`, on the reasoning objectui#5793 used for the same remediation on `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

### `.changeset/6776-metadata-admin-lazy-registration.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/package.json` → `packages/app-shell/package.json` — edited by this change

  > - `packages/app-shell/package.json`'s `sideEffects` array now names `views/metadata-admin/register-builtins` (the new leaf that performs the five registrations) instead of `views/metadata-admin/index`. The five registrations still run at package load, bare-imported by the package entry, so nothing a consumer could observe changes — but the array is a contract every consumer's bundler reads, so the swap is stated here rather than left to a diff. - The package barrel's 25 metadata-admin runtime re-exports (and 11 type-only ones) now point at their leaf modules. **Same names, same types.** They are unreachable from outside the package by any other path — `exports` is root-only — so no import an out-of-package consumer can write is affected.

### `.changeset/7122-objectstack-family-17-3-0.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > `@objectstack/client`, `core`, `formula` and `lint` each pin `@objectstack/spec` EXACTLY, so resolving the spec alone to 17.3.0 left the console bundling TWO copies of it. Moving the family with it in `pnpm-lock.yaml` collapses the duplicate; every declared range already admitted 17.3.0, so no manifest moved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f4f1f4552` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1263 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1831 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35999348701)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `577fa817`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by this seat. It was fed only the card, the PR, the two trees and the spec resolver source. Its served tier was checked by this seat against the stamp in its transcript. Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Public surface: nothing added or changed.**
  - `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is not in the diff. `exports` (`.`, `./styles.css`), `main` / `module` / `types` / `files` / `sideEffects` / `peerDependencies` are unchanged.
  - `FlowRunnerProps` and `ScreenFlowState` are byte-identical.
  - Every new symbol in `FlowRunner.tsx` is module-private: `activeFlowsBundle`, `overlayFieldCopy`, `localizeScreen` and three local types.
  - The only manifest change is the `dependencies` floor `@objectstack/spec` `^17.0.0` → `^17.3.0`. That is not a peer range and not an `exports` change. **RIGHT.**
- **The overlay is correct.**
  - The heading goes through `resolveFlowScreenTitle` with the wire `ScreenSpec`. Its `FlowScreenLike` parameter is `{ nodeId; title?; … }`, verified in the published 17.3.0 / 17.4.0 `dist/system/index.d.mts`. The lookup is `flows[flowName].screens[nodeId].title`, falling back to the literal `title`.
  - Fields are addressed by `ScreenFieldSpec.name`, over the imported `FLOW_SCREEN_FIELD_COPY_KEYS` (`['label','placeholder']`). A key is replaced only by a non-empty string, one key at a time.
  - With no bundle, the screen passes through by identity. **RIGHT.**
  - ⚠️ Nit, not blocking: the header says the resolvers are asked "with no fallback chain". At 17.3.0, the floor now admitted, a chain-less caller defaults to `["en"]` (17.4.0 defaults to `[]`). The behaviour is still right at every admitted version, because the bundle handed over is single-keyed (`{ [language]: … }`), so no second locale can match.
- **A fresh `shown` object each render breaks nothing.**
  - `ScreenView` holds no memo or effect keyed on `screen`, and `ObjectForm` stays keyed by `nodeId`.
  - `initialScreenValues` reads the payload, and `values` are keyed by field name.
  - The missing-required check and the render read the same `shown`, whose `name` / `type` / `required` / `visibleWhen` / `defaultValue` / `options` are the payload's. So the enforced set equals the drawn set. **RIGHT.**
- **The run is driven by the payload:** `resumeWith`, `idVariable`, `isObjectFormScreen` and `setScreen(outcome.screen)` all read the wire screen. **RIGHT.**
- **`description`, the chrome and `successMessage` are untouched.** Pin (7) asserts that the accessible description stays authored beside a translated heading. **RIGHT.**
- **`activeFlowsBundle`** is safe when the provider is absent, when a namespace has no `flows`, and on non-object values. With a same-named flow in several namespaces, the first in insertion order wins: deterministic, and it does not arise in the console, which has one app namespace per language. The loader edge (a payload with no `objects.*.fields` loads un-namespaced) is pre-existing and correctly reported out.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` is **RIGHT**. It fixes a declared-but-unhonoured contract, and `Clause-②: no` holds. The narrowed floor sits in `dependencies`, which is not one of `check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s publish-contract fields. Repo precedent scores exactly this remediation `patch` (`5793-spec-range-floors.md`, `6361-spec-floor-17-2-0.md`).

Prose, sentence by sentence: **TRUE**.
- "had no reader anywhere in the shipped platform": zero call sites in objectui `main`. In objectstack the only importer is the CLI's skeleton writer. `translateFlow` is absent from `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`.
- "nothing new is fetched" and "renders exactly as before" match the diff.
- "`^17.0.0` admitted three releases that do not": verified against the registry tarballs. `resolveFlowScreenTitle` and `FLOW_SCREEN_FIELD_COPY_KEYS` occur 0 times in 17.0.0, 17.1.0 and 17.2.0, and are present in 17.3.0 and 17.4.0. The controls are present in all five.

Nothing to quote.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Acceptance notes:** the `{var}` boundary, the loader edge and "no README" are all read correctly.
- **File-surface deviation:** required. Both new imports are runtime imports that first ship in 17.3.0. The lockfile diff is one importer `specifier` line, with the resolution unchanged at 17.4.0. Lockfile Integrity and Dedupe are green.
- **`Fixes #5920`:** correct. The `description` measurement is present in the report and the PR body. ⚠️ The ledger-flip relay to the objectstack spec seat is owed by the landing seat at merge; `Fixes` does not perform it.
- **`Clause-②: no`:** TRUE, measured.
- **Check-runs on `577fa817`:** 45, all terminal.
  - 41 green and 3 skipped by design.
  - 1 red, `Spec Main Shape Gate`: 21 `TS2345` `ZodSafeParseResult` annotations on the three untouched test files, against objectstack `3b5607019f6b`, and zero on any file this PR touches. That is the objectui#10229 drift, ⛔ not this PR's.
